name: Daily Task Generation
prompt: Run the orchestrator skill: read it with skill_view first, then follow its Standard Run protocol. Read MEMORY for current path/stage/bands. Check if daily_tasks for today already exist — if yes, skip. Otherwise generate today's 3 tasks (primary/review/consolidation), write them to learner.db daily_tasks table, and update MEMORY Daily Load budget. This is a silent job — do not send any message to the learner.

name: Daily Briefing
prompt: Run the cron-briefing skill: read it with skill_view first, then follow its workflow exactly.

name: Weekly Deep Assessment
prompt: Run the cron-assessment-deep skill: read it with skill_view first, then follow its workflow exactly. Picks Deep vs Biweekly by week parity and delegates to the assessment skill.

name: Word Inventory Seed
prompt: Run the cron-word-seed skill: read it with skill_view first, then follow its workflow exactly. Keep the queued_new word inventory ready in vocab.db. This is a silent maintenance job.

name: Daily Word Review
prompt: Run the cron-word-review skill: read it with skill_view first, then follow its workflow exactly. Pick one due review word from vocab.db and send the review push to Telegram. Do not introduce unseen words.

name: Daily Light Assessment
prompt: Run the cron-assessment-light skill: read it with skill_view first, then follow its workflow exactly. Silent daily MEMORY update.
